subtitle: Sweetened with jaggery | NO Palm Oil

ingredients.name: Jaggery
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Jaggery (or Gud as called in Hindi) is one of the best natural sweeteners. It helps in regulation of body temperature and detoxifies the body. It also prevents constipation and improves digestion.

ingredients.name: Milk Solids
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Milk Solids provide essential proteins and calcium that support bone development and overall growth in children.

ingredients.name: Hazelnut
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Hazelnut paste is rich in healthy fats, vitamins, and minerals, supporting brain development and immune function in kids.

ingredients.name: Cocoa Powder
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Cocoa Powder is rich in antioxidants and minerals like iron and magnesium, supporting energy and wellbeing in active kids.

fullIngredientsList: Jaggery, Milk Solids, Groundnut Oil, Hazelnut, Cocoa Powder, Dates Powder, Emulsifier (Sunflower Lecithin)

description:
🌰 Switch from sugary chocolate spreads to our rich hazelnut and cocoa spread for kids!

🚫 It contains no white or refined sugar of any kind and is sweetened only with jaggery!

🍫 No Artificial Flavours, Colours or Preservatives | No Palm Oil

Spread on bread, rotis, or anything you like!
Use as a dip for strawberries, soup sticks and more.

You may consult/talk to your nutritionist before serving.

faqs.question: What age range is the Little Joys Chocolate Spread suitable for?
faqs.answer: It is suitable for children 4–6 years. You may consult/talk to your nutritionist before serving.

faqs.question: Why is the spread naturally sweetened?
faqs.answer: Jaggery is rich in micronutrients such as magnesium, potassium, iron and zinc. They go through minimal processing before used in our product, whereas normal white sugar is far more refined.
